ledgerChecked: film.json stages.fixes is empty (round 1, no previous reviews): nothing marked fixed to confirm.
verdict: The opening, the product intro and the two time-travel bug beats work. The bug titles are legible at 1080p, the numbers (67 ms, 4 frames, 25 of 27, 258, checkpoint -1) are real and on screen, and the 258 counter is the best proof in the film. The 'fully managed' half of the message is weaker than the bug half. 'Explores' is never shown (the explore take is unused). Both rr crops in ch04 that should show the schedule chip and the add-environment line show the wrong part of the page: a 3:00 AM title over a sliced 'Test Runs / Playwri' tab bar, and a clipped Production card with pink redaction blocks under the line 'staging, preview, localhost'. The developer/critic beat is present, subtle and legible, but it is fully silent for 6.4 s and not anchored to a product shot. After one viewing a first-time viewer gets 'records every run, finds timing bugs with root cause' clearly. They get 'explores, runs on a schedule, against staging' only from narration and kinetic type, not from product proof.

messageChecklist.fully managed: said (L0401 'runs on Replay's browsers', end card 'fully managed'); 'hosted by Replay' pill in ch04-s01. OK.
messageChecklist.explores: narrated only (L0301). Visual is a kit step list, and the 'explore' take is not used in any shot. MISSING PROOF.
messageChecklist.builds journeys: step list text 'every journey run'; '1151 journeys' in tiny grey. Weak.
messageChecklist.runs on a schedule: '3:00 AM' kinetic type plus a Sep 1 to Oct 6 tick strip. The product crop meant to show the 'Tue at 3:00 AM' chip shows the tab bar instead. BROKEN PROOF.
messageChecklist.against staging: kinetic pills only. The product crop shows a Production environment (contradicts the line). BROKEN PROOF.
messageChecklist.every PR: Test Runs table with PR #3 badges, legible at 1080p. OK.
messageChecklist.recording + root cause for every bug: recording chips, root-cause card, end collage. OK.
messageChecklist.time-travel perf bugs concrete: 67 ms / 4 frames / 25 of 27 / 258 all on screen and legible. The 'a time-travel recording CAN' payoff and 'kept starting over' are not visualised.
messageChecklist.agent beat subtle: yes: 6.4 s, unnarrated, cards legible at 1080p. The '▶ replay recording' chip is hidden behind the critic card in transit.
messageChecklist.1080p legibility: Checked on full-resolution frames from render/film.mp4. Bug pages, Test Runs and agent cards are legible. The ch04-s01 tab-bar crop and the ch04-s02 card are sliced through their text.

issues.problem: The crop meant for the green schedule chip ('Tue at 3:00 AM · America/New_York', CONT-02, schedule take at add-env 11458) renders the project tab bar instead. 'Test Runs' and 'Playwri…' are cut off at the left, right and bottom (render frame at 0:24.5, sheet +0.79 to +4.0 s). The only product proof of 'on a schedule' is missing, and a sliced UI strip is on screen for 4 s.
issues.fix: Re-measure CHIP_CROP against the rendered frame, not a harness seek, and confirm on the contact sheet that the green 'Tue at 3:00 AM' chip is fully inside the crop with padding. If the scroller position is not reproducible at that mark, seek to the 'schedule' mark (8808) where the chip is visible, or crop by element bounds. Keep '3:00 AM' above it and underline the chip's '3:00 AM' on 'schedule' (L0401).

issues.problem: Under 'Against staging, a preview, even localhost', the floating card shows a Production environment for collaborative-ai-editor.brett-lamy.workers.dev, clipped top ('Proauction') and bottom ('Delete environment'). Three empty pink blocks sit over the URL row (render frame at 0:27.6). It contradicts the line and reads as broken UI. The intended strip, 'Add production, staging, development, preview, or local configuration.' (CONT-01), is not what renders.
issues.fix: Re-crop to the 'Add environment' line (verify on the sheet that the text is whole and no redaction or placeholder blocks show) and let the staging / preview / local pills lift out of the words 'staging', 'preview', 'local' in that line. Otherwise drop the Production card entirely rather than show an environment the narration doesn't name.

issues.problem: Both schedule-take crops (ch04-s01, ch04-s02) were 'MEASURED IN THE FILM HARNESS' with a single seek, but the render shows a different scroll state, so the crops land on the wrong UI. The automated QA (cards/summary.json: no fails, no suspects) did not catch that a crop's target text was missing.
issues.fix: Make crop verification part of the shot gate. After the render, OCR or eyeball the cropped region on the contact sheet and assert that the expected string (e.g. 'Tue at 3:00 AM', 'Add production') is present and unclipped. Pin the schedule take's scroller state at the mark (re-clean with a frozen scrollTop) so seeks are deterministic.

issues.problem: 'It explores your app in a real browser' has no exploration on screen. The shot is a kit step list hugging the left third of the frame, the right two-thirds is empty paper for 6.8 s, and the captured 'explore' take (Electric Forest exploration player, subtitle 'Starting the exploration of the Electric Forest app…', LOOP-10) is used nowhere in the film. A first-time viewer never sees Replay QA exploring, the first verb of the product.
issues.fix: Put the explore take as a floating screen on the right two-thirds, cropped to the exploration player and its subtitle line, playing from the 'play' mark while L0301 is spoken (L0301 0.3 to 2.72 s). Keep the step list on the left as the index, ticking 'Explore' when the subtitle appears. On L0302 'turns what it finds into user journeys' cut or zoom to a journeys list or '1151 journeys' at legible size.

issues.problem: The hook's payoff is not drawn. On 'A screen recording can't see that' the grid collapses into a small player showing 2 squares, which is right. On 'A time-travel recording can.' the film goes straight to the root-cause card and never shows the time-travel recording seeing the other 25 renders. The viewer is told, not shown, why time travel matters.
issues.fix: Between screenrec (3.86) and rootcause (6.94), on 'A time-travel recording can' (about 5.5 to 6.6 s): run the scrubber backwards (the kit rewind), and as it passes the commit, re-light all 27 squares, with the 25 wasted ones as outlined ghosts labelled 'rendered · no DOM change'. Then resolve into the root-cause card. Also strip the literal backticks from the card ('`SidebarProjectList`' should read 'SidebarProjectList').

issues.problem: 'It never saved its place, so it kept starting over' (L0508, 4.88 to 7.93 s) is static: frames from +5.0 to +7.9 s are identical (the 258 counter, the checkpoint -1 flag, the histogram). The snapback beat at 5.07 has no visible motion, so 'starting over' is not shown.
issues.fix: On 'starting over', run a small playhead along the histogram that advances a few bars and snaps back to the checkpoint -1 flag, three times on the beat, with the flag pulsing each time. Keep the 258 counter and the 'no keypresses' note as they are.

issues.problem: L0504 'No click. A background refresh re-rendered the project list.' (7.67 to 11.02 s): the only motion is a struck cursor drifting in at the right edge, outside the screen, and nothing depicts the background refresh. The frame ribbon labels ('67 ms', 'illustration · 16.7 ms frame budget') sit in a large, mostly empty dark panel.
issues.fix: Move the struck cursor onto the Replay panel near the ribbon. On 'background refresh' send a small 'RTK-Query refetch' pulse into the ribbon that triggers the long 67 ms commit block. Zoom the RrwebScreen about 1.15x towards the ribbon so the panel is not mostly empty.

issues.problem: At b-pill (+1.37 s, render 0:30.05) the bracket closes over an empty gap above the table, and its red-pink mark runs through the 'Environment' header like a strikethrough, while the PR #3 badges it should point to sit below, unmarked.
issues.fix: Bracket the column of PR #3 badges (or the first two badges) and draw the red-pink underline beneath 'Environment', not through it. Hold the bracket on 'pull request' (L0403 ends 1.86 s).

issues.problem: The developer/critic beat is subtle and legible, but the '▶ replay recording' chip travels behind the critic card (render 0:67.5 shows only '▶ r'), so the handoff object is never readable. The beat floats on the haze with only a bug title rather than sitting in the corner of a product shot.
issues.fix: Draw the chip above both cards (z-order) and pause it mid-path for about 0.5 s with the full label '▶ replay recording' visible before it enters the critic. Optionally keep a faded bug-sync screen behind at 0.6 scale so the pair reads as working on that bug. Keep it unnarrated.

issues.problem: The blown-up typed URL is right-anchored: the caret sits about 80 px from the right edge and the text grows leftwards from there ('https://|' alone at the far right at +0.71 s), with a blurred ghost at the left. The composition looks off-centre and the first keystrokes appear at the frame edge.
issues.fix: Centre the final string (or left-anchor it at x of about 240 so it grows rightwards with the caret), keep 120 px or more of safe margin, and remove the left ghost or make it the blurred New-project page behind.

issues.problem: The end card never prints the hook the narrator closes on ('Catch bugs that only exist in time'), and a black '▶ recording' chip sits next to the Replay QA wordmark, which reads like a UI badge, not a brand lock-up.
issues.fix: Under the bracketed '{ End-to-end testing · fully managed }', add a second smaller line 'Catch bugs that only exist in time.' as L0602 speaks it. Remove the recording chip from the lock-up (or fade it out by the time the URL types).

issues.problem: The colour sweep on 'Or remember to run.' turns 'remember to' pale peach on a peach haze: low contrast in the landed frame (+3.54 s).
issues.fix: End the sweep at a deeper orange (#f06a3c or similar) or add a soft dark text shadow so the swept words stay readable against the haze.

issues.problem: QA reports 'listening' pending human sign-off for 'localhost', 'Against' and 'QA'. Pacing is 190 to 199 wpm on several lines (L0202, L0301, L0302, L0401, L0402, L0508, L0601), brisk for a voice-led promo over a 909 kick.
issues.fix: Get the human sign-off (film:voice signoff). If the fast lines feel rushed on listen, re-take L0301/L0401 at about 175 wpm. ch03-s01 and ch04-s01 have slack to absorb it.

best_moments: ch05-s04: the 258 counter racing up beside the live bug title with '258' bracketed in it, the checkpoint -1 flag and '≈160 s · 2 clicks, no keypresses'. The most concrete, convincing time-only bug in the film.

ch05-s02: the real bug title '67ms React commit … drops 4 frames' legible at 1080p, with the '67ms' bracketed exactly on 'Sixty-seven milliseconds' and four outlined dropped frames on 'Four dropped frames'.
ch05-s03: 27 squares collapsing to '25 of 27 renders changed nothing', then the screen-recording frame that shows only the 2 that changed. A clear picture of why a video can't see it.
ch02-s02: 'Set up QA for your app' at full legibility with the typed staging URL carried in from the blown-up prompt, plus 'quick chat' underlined on 'Just a quick chat'.
ch05-s05: the agent pair handled as a silent beat ('✕ not yet' then '✓ good') as the brand haze drains to paper. Subtle, as the brief asked.
